# Financial and external-account measurability audit

Prepared 2026-09-22 for the 35-entry `V6_calibration_core.tex` register. This is a feasibility and definition audit, not a new estimation or a refresh of the historical empirical package. Originals were preserved.

## Classification convention

Use two axes. **D** means the explicitly named statistical counterpart is observable from source data with accounting/unit transformations. **I** means the model coordinate requires a substantive bridge or reconstruction. **L** means a structural or latent model object has no unique observable counterpart. Separately, **conditional** means the statistic exists but the model population, claim, timing, or numeraire must be fixed. A D/conditional entry does not certify an exact HKT mapping. In particular, whole-economy international positions do not directly measure the young cohort's investable wealth.

## Live verification

A useful route for the equity-weight denominator is available once consistent equity-market sizes are measured. Write external equity assets as E_A and liabilities as E_L. Then omega = (Q_US - E_L)/(Q_US - E_L + E_A), and omega-star = E_L/(Q_W - E_A + E_L). These formulas require exactly matched equity/fund/FDI universes, residence aggregation and intermediary consolidation. They do not justify using operating-asset EV in place of equity supply, or treating an incomplete OECD RoW as the complete residual world.

`fred_curl_probe_log.json` records exact endpoint URLs, saved dates, row counts, checksums, latest observations and statuses. Raw response bodies are unchanged under `raw/`. The successful probe downloaded **19 exact series**: 16 quarterly series ending 2026Q2, one monthly yield ending August 2026, and two annual dividend series ending 2025. The request window starts in 2024, so these are saved-sample coverage dates, not claims about full source history. All saved samples have unique sorted dates. The gross-assets-minus-gross-liabilities NFA identity holds exactly for every saved quarter.

The narrow OpenEcon query requested ROWEISQ027S and explicitly prohibited substitutions. It nevertheless returned BOGZ1FL263164100Q. The exact source gave 2026Q2 ROWEISQ027S = 28,057,583 million USD; the substitute gave 16,752,466. The **11,305,117 million USD** difference reflects a substantively different equity universe. The substitution was rejected and retained in `openecon_response.json`; no data from it are certified as the requested series. `probe_fred.py` records a Python-urllib timeout route. Direct curl succeeded and is the reproducible download route. Two attempted FRED other-changes FV codes returned 404; this is an endpoint-access finding, not evidence that the underlying Fed concept is nonexistent.

FRED pages returned by web search sometimes contain an older indexed release. Latest dates and values above are from the **live graph CSV**, not those cached excerpts.

## Material issue in the exploratory mappings

Current source definitions must be preserved, rather than importing the old shorthand “equity and investment fund shares” everywhere:

- [ROWEIS / FL263181105 analyzer](https://www.federalreserve.gov/apps/fof/SeriesAnalyzer.aspx?s=FL263181105&t=): current total ROW equity liabilities add foreign corporate equities **excluding foreign investment-fund shares**, US government equity in international organizations, and US direct-investment equity abroad at market value.
- [ROWEIN / FL263081005 analyzer](https://www.federalreserve.gov/apps/fof/SeriesAnalyzer.aspx?s=FL263081005&t=): equity assets add US corporate equities **and investment-fund shares** and inward-direct-investment equity at market value. Its matching revaluation link is FR263081005.
- The exploratory AHP code pairs ROWEINQ027S with FR263081115, which excludes mutual/money-market fund shares. In 2026Q2, FR263081005 is 3,921,264 million USD and FR263081115 is 3,718,464 million USD: a **202,800 million USD** difference. This is a verified scope difference, not a reason to overwrite the legacy series automatically. Matching levels, transactions, revaluations and other changes must be reconciled before the resulting price chain is called a direct measure. No exploratory baseline was edited.

The [BEA 2026 Concepts and Methods](https://www.bea.gov/sites/default/files/2026-06/BEA-International-Economic-Accounts-Concepts-and-Methods.pdf), chapter 8 (printed p.43) distinguishes transactions, price/exchange-rate revaluations and other changes. Chapter 24 (printed pp.207--208) explains portfolio-security price and exchange-rate adjustments and the introduction of reported TIC-SLT fair-value changes in 2023. These definitions support retaining a measurement bridge for the model's pure equity-price VA.

For bonds, [Treasury TIC Table 5](https://ticdata.treasury.gov/Publish/slt_table5.html), currently through July 2026, covers marketable and nonmarketable bills/notes/bonds and explicitly cautions that custody location need not identify final country ownership. This source is useful evidence on safe-asset demand, but not an exact measure of theta-US-star.

## Rerun and limitations

Run `python3 probe_fred_curl.py`, then `python3 build_validation.py` from this directory. This intentionally replaces only this new evidence snapshot on rerun; retain it or copy it before selecting a new vintage. `spot_checks.csv` and `validation.json` reproduce the highlighted identities and scope differences. No external message was sent and no protected dataset was downloaded in this subtask. No full historical sample, national portfolio denominator, consolidated RoW balance sheet or model identification exercise was constructed.

Memory registry lines 503--511 were used only to locate the existing annual-mapping package; all substantive conclusions above were checked against current local artifacts and live source probes.
